title: Backrooms: Reworked
description: A immerisve minecraft backroom experience. To give you a great scare
body:
Dwell into a whole new dimension in Backrooms: Reworked.

Where do i start?: Place gravel or sand to suffocate to no-clip, essientials is built in as well as other handy mods for the most optimal friends experience. This modpack additionlly incorporates preformance mods for lower end pc's.

The goal: The purpose of this modpack is to grant a fun and engaging expereince. It's meant to be a fun co-op experience. That gives you the chills. The modpack adds voicechat and other co-op mods to richen the experience so remember to bring a friend!

What should should my fps be?: For lower end pcs fps can range from 60 to 120 fps. Higher end pc's can reach well above 200 fps.
